name: meta_xr_bridge
summary: Godot autoload (class MetaXRBridge) that probes XRServer.find_interface('OpenXR'), initializes the interface when present, and detects Meta Quest extensions XR_FB_passthrough + XR_EXT_hand_tracking via OpenXRInterface. Stays in stub mode (defaults: false / Vector3.ZERO) when OpenXR is unavailable. Emits cross-process events to ~/.cc/godot_xr_events.jsonl for the cc side to ingest.
engine_pattern: Singleton Node autoload. _ready() probes OpenXR once and caches _xr_available. Feature detection uses OpenXRInterface typed helpers (is_passthrough_supported / is_hand_tracking_supported) with fallback to is_extension_supported('XR_FB_passthrough' | 'XR_EXT_hand_tracking'). All public methods short-circuit to defaults in stub mode and log via print() + jsonl emit.
signals: controller_input(side: String, button: String, pressed: bool)

env_vars.META_QUEST_APP_ID: Meta developer dashboard app id (used by deployment / store linking, not runtime probing)
env_vars.META_QUEST_API_KEY: Meta developer API key (used by build / submission tooling)

runtime_requirements.viewport: main viewport.use_xr is set true on successful init

stub_mode.trigger: OpenXR interface null OR initialize() fails
stub_mode.log_line: OpenXR interface unavailable; meta_xr_bridge in stub mode

cross_process_events.schema: { ts: float, event: str, scene_uid: str, details: dict }

guarantees: Graceful degradation — runs anywhere, no OpenXR required to load the project
Idempotent _probe_openxr — initialize() only called when not already initialized
No new project.godot sections added — [xr] is deferred to phase 2 (vendor plugin task)
Every significant event emits to ~/.cc/godot_xr_events.jsonl for cross-process visibility
blockers_phase_2: godot-openxr-vendors submodule (separate task) for the Meta XR Loader plugin
